commit.message:
feat(tools): shrink-fit chucks, BT50 and CAT50 holders; every taper is a spindle mount

The holder library gets DIN 69882-8 shrink-fit chucks on each taper
but TTS (one envelope of the 4.5-degree nose cone and the 45-degree
flare, 2 mm over the table in radius), BT50 and CAT50 with ER16-ER40
and every Weldon bore, and a grouped "<taper> Shrink" picker row.
SPINDLE_MOUNTS lists each library taper; an app test keeps the two
lists equal, and an unknown mount is still refused by name. Numbers
and sources: docs/decisions/3919-standard-holders-2.md.

Refs #3919
Fixes #4239

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(tools): group the picker rows without a borrow across the closure

Refs #3919

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(tools): SK50 holders and ER50 collet chucks on the 40 and 50 tapers

The holder library gets the DIN 69871 SK50 taper (ER16-ER50 and every
Weldon bore, gauge 100) and the ER50 collet size (Ø5-34, Ø78 nut drawn
40 long) on BT40, CAT40, SK40, BT50, CAT50 and SK50. SK50 joins
SPINDLE_MOUNTS after SK40. Numbers and sources, and the items left out
(SK50 shrink-fit, TG, Morse, NMTB, hydraulic and milling chucks, SF32),
are in docs/decisions/3919-standard-holders-3.md.

Refs #3919

fix(app): built-in shrink-fit chucks in the component library

The merge of main brought the component library (#4233), whose holder
conversion matched only Er and Weldon. Clamp::Shrink gave E0004.

A shrink-fit chuck now maps to an adaptive item with its taper as the
machine side and a plain bore CYL <bore> as the workpiece side (no
collet). Its geometry is the holder library's own outline at the
library gauge length. Pinned by builtin_shrink in tool_library_holders.
